tool.name: SemiBin2 generate_sequence_features_multi
tool.description: Generate sequence features for multi-sample SemiBin2
tool.command: SemiBin2 generate_sequence_features_multi \ --input-fasta '$input_fasta' \ --output '$output_dir' \ #if $input_bam: --input-bam '$input_bam' #end if #if $input_abundance: --input-abundance '$input_abundance' #end if #if $separator: --separator '$separator' #end if #if $prodigal_output_faa: --prodigal-output-faa '$prodigal_output_faa' #end if #if $prodigal_output_gff: --prodigal-output-gff '$prodigal_output_gff' #end if #if $allow_missing_mmseqs2: --allow-missing-mmseqs2 #end if #if $verbose: --verbose #end if #if $quiet: --quiet #end if

param.name: separator
param.label: Sample separator
param.help: Separator used to split sample names from contig names

data.name: output_dir
data.label: SemiBin2 multi-sample sequence features output directory

tool.help:
**What it does**
Generate sequence features (k-mer frequency and abundance) for multi-sample SemiBin2 binning.
**Changes in v2.5.0**
- Deprecated `--prodigal-output-faa` (no longer used) - Deprecated `--allow-missing-mmseqs2` (no-op)
**Usage**
Generate features with BAM files:
```bash SemiBin2 generate_sequence_features_multi -i concatenated.fa -b *.bam -o output ```
Generate features with abundance files:
```bash SemiBin2 generate_sequence_features_multi -i concatenated.fa -a *.txt -o output ```
**Citation**
Pan S, Zhu C, Zhao XM, Coelho LP. A deep siamese neural network improves metagenome-assembled genomes in microbiome datasets across different environments. *Nature Communications* 2022. DOI: 10.1038/s41467-022-29843-y
Pan S, Zhao XM, Coelho LP. SemiBin2: self-supervised contrastive learning leads to better MAGs for short- and long-read sequencing. *Bioinformatics* 2023. DOI: 10.1093/bioinformatics/btad209
